subject: Role granularity and compensation boundary review — L4/L5/L6
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: Calibration request — Mehta candidate (scope vs title)

Hi Laura / Tessa,

Quick one — attached is the comp matrix and the role brief for Suresh Mehta (interview loop completed last week). Hiring manager is recommending a People Lead (L5 Manager) route because the role may need direct reports in Q2, but the interview panel flagged the candidate as high IC impact (architecture + cross-org influence) which pushes toward Staff (L6) as an IC.

Numbers: hiring manager asked for USD 210k base + equity. Our L5 manager band midpoint is ~180–200k, L6 IC midpoint ~220k. I attached comp_matrix_Q1_2027.xlsx and a draft offer for your reference.

Can we do a quick calibration on level vs title boundary and whether we should make an exception here? If we move to L6 IC, comp delta is ~20–30k against manager comp. If we stick to L5 manager, the title maps better to headcount plans.

Ask: Laura — can you advise on risk tolerance for making an L6 IC hire for this role? Tessa — any guidance on people-ops / payroll friction if we treat as manager later?

Thanks,
Marissa
--
Marissa Cole | Sr. Recruiting Partner | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-11T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Calibration request — Mehta candidate (scope vs title)

Thanks for the summary, Marissa.

A couple quick asks before I weigh in:
- Jonas — can you draft 2–3 bullets on what differentiates L5 Manager vs L6 Staff in our current ladder for this org (scope, org-level influence, IC deliverables)?
- Marissa — please confirm org chart (is there an immediate direct-report need) and a 12-month hiring plan for the team. If reports are not required in the first 3 months, an IC route is easier to justify.

High-level: I am not opposed to hiring at L6 if the candidate truly operates at that scope and we can justify long-term unit economics. My priority is consistency: we should avoid ad-hoc promotions later to retro-fit titles. If we do L5 manager now and need to bump to L6 within 6 months, that looks like a leveling exception and sets a precedent.

Looping Jonas for calibration notes; plan a 15-min sync if needed.

Best,
Laura
--
Laura Bennett | VP, Talent & Org | Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-12T14:22:00Z
Subject: Calibration notes — L5 Manager vs L6 Staff (Mehta)

Attached are my calibration notes (calibration_notes_jonas.docx). TL;DR:
- L6 (Staff) expectations: drives cross-product architecture decisions, owns technical strategy beyond immediate team, mentor to multiple teams, measurable platform/throughput impact.
- L5 Manager expectations: owns team delivery, people management, tactical roadmap execution; influence primarily within own org slice.

Candidate assessment (per interviews):
- Deep systems architecture experience, led infra redesign at prior employer with measurable latency wins.
- Limited direct people management in last 3 years — has mentored but not managed more than 2 direct reports.
- Strong cross-org credibility (presented to execs), can operate at scope required for Staff if we commit to giving IC ownership (not people ops).

Recommendation options:
1) Offer as L6 Staff (IC) with base ~215k — requires documentation of IC scope and sign-off from product lead to ensure long-term project ownership.
2) Offer as L5 Manager with manager title and base ~195k — requires immediate people plan (1 direct report to hire in Q2) and clear path to promotion if IC scope expands.

My vote is Option 1 if org can guarantee IC scope; otherwise Option 2 to align with headcount plan.

Jonas
Senior Director, Eng Effectiveness
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-14T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Calibration notes — L5 Manager vs L6 Staff (Mehta)

Agree with Jonas' assessment. Two operational points:
- Payroll / benefits: if we make the comp decision > band midpoint for L5 to approximate an L6 comp, we need C&B signoff and to record the rationale in HIRE-2027-391.
- Headcount: if we don't have an immediate IC project that requires cross-org ownership, hiring as Manager (L5) reduces risk to bench/idle IC capacity. We should decide quickly because candidate has competing offers.

If the hiring manager can guarantee a 6–12 month IC ownership plan, I will clear the comp exception pathway; otherwise recommend Manager title.

—Tessa
Head of People Ops
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@talenthub.com>, Suresh Mehta <suresh.mehta@gmail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-16T10:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Calibration decision and proposed offer

Anita / Suresh — looping you in with our proposed offer. We discussed two routes internally: L6 Staff (IC) at base 215k or L5 Manager at base 195k. The hiring team is leaning toward L6 Staff provided Suresh is comfortable with an IC-first scope and we formalize the ownership areas.

Attached: S_Mehta_offer_v2.pdf (draft offer). Can you confirm Suresh's preference on title/track and whether the 215k base works? If candidate prefers manager route, we will adjust title and comp accordingly but may need to accelerate hiring of a direct report in Q2.

Thanks — we're trying to get this wrapped by Monday.

Marissa
From: Suresh Mehta <suresh.mehta@gmail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Anita Rao <anita.rao@talenthub.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-18T15:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Calibration decision and proposed offer

Thanks everyone — appreciate the transparency. I am excited by the IC scope and would prefer the Staff (L6) IC track if the organization can guarantee the cross-team ownership you referenced. 215k base is acceptable.

A couple clarifying Qs:
- Can you include in the offer a short summary of the initial 6–9 month IC deliverables (so expectations are aligned)?
- If the team needs me to take on people management later, will title/comp be revisited?

Marissa / Laura — happy to sign once those clarifications are in the offer.

Best,
Suresh
